title: SALT2 empirical temporal training and residual-error conditioning

scopes.title: Empirical spectral sequence, selected training ancestry and conditional error propagation
scopes.checked_claim: Guy Sec2 Eq1 defines F=x0[M0(p,lambda)+x1*M1(p,lambda)+...]exp[c*CL(lambda)], with rest-frame phase since B maximum and rest-frame wavelength; global components/color law and per-SN fitted normalization/components/color. Color can include intrinsic variation or dust or both. Sec2.1/2.2/3 condition the empirical model on heterogeneous ensemble coverage, photometric spectral recalibration, assumed white spectral noise, chosen spectral weights, premaximum sampling and model-dependent host-contamination cuts. Sec4 fits components and calibration together, using second-derivative regularization in weakly constrained regions. Historical construction spans−20..+50 days and2000..9200 Angstrom. Sec6 estimates residual errors by leave-one-SN-out retraining and per-SN refitting; remaining correlations are acknowledged before an assumed diagonal simplification. Component covariance projected by H0/H1 and rescaled by S(p,lambda) is training-model uncertainty. Brout IV.1/IV.3 retrains B21 with changed zeropoints/filter functions; nine calibration variants propagate jointly through retraining and light-curve refitting. Survey zeropoint draws are correlated, effective-wavelength shifts are uncorrelated inputs in that analysis. Pantheon+ fitting3000..7000 Angstrom is distinct from c447 MODEL000 INFO range2800..7000. INFO/README configuration literals and nominal/variant roles are checked.
scopes.unresolved: The empirical sequence is not a first-principles emitted-luminosity, photon-arrival, detector/extraction or selection likelihood. Full MODEL000 grid/column/flux normalization, version1 color polynomial/extrapolation, relative-error normalization/interpolation and covariance closure remain unresolved. Historical basis support is not complete observed coverage or current released support. Training-object/calibrator overlap and unknown cross-covariance require explicit lineage; no fitted x0/x1/c summary is accepted as a native law.

limitations: Guy Sec2.1 permits basis dependence in poorly constrained regions. Sec4.2 regularization introduces estimator bias, assessed by author simulations based on SALT; the reported0.005mag K-correction criterion is conditional, not an independent accuracy certificate. Historical10x120/10x60 basis sizes are not released grid dimensions.

Guy Sec3 selection requires premaximum sampling, excludes1991bg-like SNe and uses the fitted model to assess host contamination. Spectra share light-curve calibration and host subtraction; exact event-level training/evaluation overlap, selection probabilities and cross-covariances remain unchecked.

Guy Sec6 uses jackknife retraining because a separate large validation sample was unavailable. Remaining residuals are still correlated; independent residual treatment assumes temporal correlation shorter than typical sampling. Full component covariance is not a measured joint detector or event covariance.

Original Guy PDF6/HTML S6.Ex8 prints H0,i multiplying both M0 and M1 in the residual normalization equation, while the preceding variance expression uses H0/H1 separately and Sec4.3 gives different basis sizes. The literal indices are preserved; an executable basis reconciliation is unresolved.

Brout IV.3 jointly propagates training/fitting perturbations to distance covariance; VI.p8 says filter shifts were omitted from the simultaneous calibration fit and varied in training without zeropoint correlations. This model choice does not establish zero physical cross-covariance. Source-added training, CALSPEC and CSP systematics remain conditional choices.

The release README's broad nine-correlated-realizations wording is kept distinct from the paper's correlated-zeropoint/uncorrelated-wavelength split. Nine variants are systematic analysis perturbations. Paper sigma_k=1/3, historical ALL.fitopts0.3 and nonzero shift_0 remain distinct; nominal MODEL000 mapping is not inferred from suffix0.

SALT2.INFO options, SIGMA_INT0.106 and error-floor literals do not establish units/distributions of released error maps, a Gaussian optical state, physical reddening, held-out accuracy or a complete measured noise law. Absolute flux normalization, color-law version mapping and all unexamined template/reader bodies remain open.

Only listed original-source passages and one historical coverage figure are checked. Full training tables, standards/filter bodies, cited training sources and unlisted figures/appendices remain unexamined.
